user_query: Our full-time domestic help stole my mother's gold bangles from the locked cupboard while we were out and ran away. The police are saying it is a simple theft.
legal_text_raw: Whoever, being a clerk or servant, or being employed in the capacity of a clerk or servant, commits theft in respect of any property in the possession of his master or employer, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
layman_explanation: The police are downplaying it. Theft by a servant or employee is an 'Aggravated Theft'. Under the BNS, this carries a significantly higher penalty (up to 7 years jail) compared to general theft, because it involves a breach of trust. Insist they file it under Section 305 BNS.

user_query: A local politician gave a speech in our colony yesterday explicitly telling people to boycott and attack shops owned by our community. People are already throwing stones today.
legal_text_raw: Whoever by words, either spoken or written, or by signs or by visible representations or otherwise, promotes or attempts to promote, on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, caste or community... disharmony or feelings of enmity, hatred or ill-will...
layman_explanation: This is legally classified as 'Hate Speech' that promotes enmity between groups. You must immediately report this to the Superintendent of Police along with video evidence of the speech, as it is a serious non-bailable offense under Section 196 BNS.

user_query: I bought an expensive asthma inhaler for my son from a local pharmacy. It turned out to be a fake expiry-tampered product, and my son had a severe asthma attack requiring hospitalization.
legal_text_raw: Whoever adulterates any drug or medical preparation in such a manner as to lessen the efficacy or change the operation of such drug or medical preparation... or knowingly sells... shall be punished with imprisonment... which may extend to six months, or with fine...
layman_explanation: Selling adulterated or fake medicines is a criminal offense under the BNS, not just a consumer issue. Keep the inhaler and the bill intact as evidence. File an FIR immediately against the pharmacy owner under BNS and also complain to the State Drug Controller.

user_query: The local Police Station Inspector flat out refused to register my FIR against a politically connected builder who grabbed my land. He verbally abused me and threw me out.
legal_text_raw: Any person aggrieved by a refusal on the part of an officer in charge of a police station to record the information... may send the substance of such information, in writing and by post, to the Superintendent of Police concerned who, if satisfied that such information discloses the commission of a cognizable offence, shall either investigate the case himself or direct an investigation...
layman_explanation: If the local station refuses your FIR, you have a direct legal remedy. Draft your complaint, attach evidence, and send it via Registered Post directly to the Superintendent of Police (SP) or Commissioner of Police (CP) of your district invoking Section 173(4) BNSS.

user_query: Can the police just arrest me without a warrant if my neighbor files a false complaint saying I slapped him during a parking argument?
legal_text_raw: Any police officer may without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant, arrest any person... who has been concerned in any cognizable offence, or against whom a reasonable complaint has been made... provided the offence is punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years...
layman_explanation: For minor offenses (non-cognizable or punishable by less than 7 years, like a simple slap), the police generally cannot arrest you without a warrant from a Magistrate. They are legally mandated to first issue you a 'Notice of Appearance' (Section 35 BNSS).

user_query: My cousin has been inside central jail for 95 days now, but the police still haven't filed a charge sheet or submitted any final investigation report to the judge. What can we do?
legal_text_raw: Where the investigation is not completed within the period of ninety days [for severe crimes] or sixty days [for other crimes]... the accused person shall be released on bail if he is prepared to and does furnish bail...
layman_explanation: Your cousin is now legally entitled to 'Default Bail' (also known as Statutory Bail). If the police fail to file the charge sheet within 90 days (or 60 days depending on the crime), the court MUST grant bail regardless of the merits of the case. Your lawyer must apply immediately.

user_query: The police beat me up in the lockup and forced me to sign a confession paper on blank paper. Will the judge send me to jail based solely on this paper?
legal_text_raw: A confession made to a police officer shall not be proved as against a person accused of any offence... Provided that, when any fact is deposed to as discovered in consequence of information received from a person accused of any offence, in the custody of a police-officer, so much of such information... may be proved.
layman_explanation: No. Under Indian Evidence Law, any confession made to a police officer while in custody is legally inadmissible in court. It holds no evidentiary value unless that confession led the police to physically discover new evidence (like a weapon).

user_query: My sister committed suicide. Her husband claims she was depressed, but we know he and his parents tortured her daily for bringing a cheap car in dowry. Who has to prove she was murdered?
legal_text_raw: When the question is whether a person has committed the dowry death of a woman and it is shown that soon before her death such woman had been subjected by such person to cruelty or harassment for, or in connection with, any demand for dowry, the Court shall presume that such person had caused the dowry death.
layman_explanation: In cases of 'Dowry Death' within 7 years of marriage, Indian evidence law specifically reverses the burden of proof. If you can show she was harassed for dowry recently, the court automatically presumes the husband/in-laws are guilty, and *they* must prove their innocence.

user_query: My phone lost network suddenly. Two hours later, I got an email saying my bank account was wiped clean. I found out later someone had gone to the telecom store and got a duplicate SIM issued in my name!
legal_text_raw: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine...
layman_explanation: You are a victim of 'SIM Swap Fraud'. Immediately freeze your bank accounts, notify the bank within 3 days (to ensure zero liability on you as per RBI guidelines), and register an FIR under Section 66C of the IT Act for identity theft against the fraudsters and telecom provider negligence.

source_act: Section 67 & 67A, Information Technology Act, 2000 & Section 318 BNS
user_query: I took a loan of 5000 rupees from a random instant loan app. Now they have hacked my contacts and are sending morphed pornographic photos of my face to my family members demanding 50,000 rupees.
legal_text_raw: Whoever publishes or transmits or causes to be published or transmitted in the electronic form any material which contains sexually explicit act or conduct shall be punished... with imprisonment... which may extend to five years...
layman_explanation: This is the notorious 'Loan App Extortion' scam. Do NOT pay them any more money; they will never stop. Turn off your phone, inform your family immediately that you are being blackmailed via AI deepfakes, and file a complaint firmly at 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in.
